title: Nonnegativity of the column marginal
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a joint distribution on $\mathrm{Fin}\,M \times \mathrm{Fin}\,N$, and let $j$ be a column action. Then the column marginal $\sigma^{\mathrm{col}}_j = \sum_{i} \sigma_{ij}$ satisfies $\sigma^{\mathrm{col}}_j \ge 0$.
hypotheses_covered: σ is a joint distribution on Fin M × Fin N
j is a column action (element of Fin N)
replaced:
For any joint distribution $\sigma$ and column action $j$,
$\sigma^{\mathrm{col}}_j \ge 0$.
